zones.label: < Select these 12 Functions with a touch or select a Keyboard equivalent.
To be able to Edit, logon as 'Editor'. Set your password here.
Important Tip: When building your menu, instead of building each menu item button from scratch, copy an already completed button and rename it to make new button with the same properties.

Copy currently selected Button(s) on this Page.
Also, copy Button(s) from other pages to this page.
Jump to a page by selecting its name or number.
Show Information about a Button's Properties: Formal Name, Family, Printer Destination, Class, Item Type, Jump/Move* Target.

Select all buttons on the page.
Also, Invert the selected state of All buttons.
Page Navigation Functions are critically important.  They allow movement among the Pages, for example, to move 'Selected' Buttons from one Page to Another.
Show the list of Pages by Page name & Number.

Move selected button(s) from other Page(s) to this page.
Erase them from other Page(s).

Make a new Page. 
Set Resolution, Page # (ID), Page Function, Page Appearance Properties.
Make a new Button in top left corner.
< The Edit ToolBar has 9 Tools for Building Pages and Buttons, plus 3 Functions for Navigating through Pages.
Move to next page in numerical order.
Set or Change the Global Default Appearance Properties of all Pages.
Toggle the inverse state of all buttons. Selected buttons will be unselected. Unselected buttons will be selected.
Move to prior page in numerical order.
F11 Toggles Edit Mode on & off, Discards Changes (Reverts)
F1 Toggles Edit Mode On & Off, Saves Changes
